run_Generator_dense_embeddings: run the Generator script to generate dense embeddings from a passages TSV file for a FAISS index
encode_passages_with_model: encode passages using a TorchRankerAgent candidate encoder and return passage embeddings as a tensor
load_passages_from_tsv: load passages from a TSV file and shard them by shard id and number of shards
save_embeddings_and_ids: save encoded passage embeddings and corresponding document IDs to separate PyTorch files
setup_args_Generator: setup command line arguments for passages file, output file, num shards, shard id, and DPR model flag
